notes:
Receive tab redesigned: the add-medicine panel now stays open beside the running purchase — add a line and the panel clears itself, ready for the next one.
Click any item in the list to load it back into the panel and edit it.
Purchase details (supplier, date, invoice, payment) now sit in one compact strip above the items.
Short-dated batches show a months-left warning in the items list.
Ctrl and + now files the current medicine and clears the panel.
